$comment: Single source of truth for Unity versions exercised by CI and tools/check-unity-versions.* local script. Versions are pinned to specific patch releases (no floating tags) per acceptance criteria in CoplayDev/unity-mcp#1107. Every id MUST have a corresponding GameCI Docker image at unityci/editor:ubuntu-<id>-base-3 since both CI (game-ci/unity-test-runner@v4) and local --docker mode pull from there. Verify availability before bumping: https://hub.docker.com/v2/repositories/unityci/editor/tags/?name=<id>
$coverageGap: The 'floor' version (2020.2) may not have a GameCI Docker image — verify at https://hub.docker.com/r/unityci/editor before enabling CI for this version. All UNITY_2021_OR_NEWER / UNITY_2022_OR_NEWER / UNITY_6000_OR_NEWER flags are OFF when building against floor.
$defaultVersionComment: Unity version used when CI runs the narrow matrix (default PR feedback path). Pinned to floor — the minimum supported version.

versions.notes: Package minimum (matches MCPForUnity/package.json 'unity' field and TestProjects/UnityMCPTests/ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt). All UNITY_2021_*/UNITY_2022_*/UNITY_6000_* flags OFF.
Last 2022 LTS. Exercises UNITY_2022_1/2/3_OR_NEWER branches; UNITY_2023_*/UNITY_6000_* OFF. Catches FindObjectsByType-style regressions (the #1105 path).
Unity 6.0 LTS (latest patch on GameCI). UNITY_6000_0_OR_NEWER ON (27 files), UNITY_2023_*_OR_NEWER ON, UNITY_6000_3/4/5/6 OFF.
Latest 6.x available on GameCI. UNITY_6000_0/1/2/3/4_OR_NEWER ON; UNITY_6000_5/6 OFF (no GameCI image yet — see $coverageGap).
